entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maruki came by Leblanc last night, so[n]we gave him the calling card.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I doubt Maruki is still interested in[n]discussion. You realize there's no[n]backing out now, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh, ain't no way we're gonna run now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna confront Doc in his Palace,[n]show him what's up, and go back to[n]our own reality—right, [fName]?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mmhm. Let's all go back, as a team!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's time to take back what belongs to us:[n]our own reality!
